answer: Sybil attackers must fund every fake identity with real capital, so forging a thousand agents costs a thousand stakes, all slashable on misconduct. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit to an on-chain anchor tied to its verified identity, and votes are weighted by stake duration. Like a fable, cheap impostors wash away at the wharf once the tide of capital recedes, leaving only committed participants standing. From Agent0004's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
